payload.title: The knowledge run as a scheduled agent on the container executor
payload.description:
The weekly knowledge run is compute-heavy and is not a short wake-up. Keep its Step Functions and Fargate executor, and start it through the standard: a definition with a schedule, a wake, a run record with an outcome, the site's pause and budget. The executor is a field of the definition (`lambda` by default, `container` for this). This is the container half of the one run contract (PPY-433383).

**Acceptance criteria**
- The knowledge run starts from a wake and records one run with an outcome.
- Pausing the agent stops the next run.
- The projection lease and the stale-checkout guard are unchanged.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- knowledge-run-agent.feature: the weekly tick starts one execution; a paused agent starts none; a failed stage ends `failed` before projection.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** Knowledge-run stack: started by the wake instead of its own schedule.

**Part of:** Every other responsibility as an agent. Slice code M9 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
